caption:
Tuesday check-in from your element 📱 Swipe to find yours.

Today is Yang Wood over Earth: a big tree on solid ground. Good for long plans; watch the stubborn streak.

Your element is the day you were born, not your zodiac animal. Find it free at the link in bio.

Which one are you? Tell us below.

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #astrology #selfdiscovery #knowyourself #metaphysics #fourpillars #chineseastrology #fengshuitips #singapore
day_line: A great tree on fallen soil. Rooted and steady: good for long plans, watch the stubborn streak.

lines.Yang Wood: Same energy as you all around today. Back each other up; don't argue over who leads.
lines.Yin Wood: Someone's chasing the same goal today. Cheer them on and keep your notes private.
lines.Yang Fire: Odd ideas make sense today. Note them on your phone before the MRT doors open.
lines.Yin Fire: An old piece of advice finally clicks today. Send the person a thank-you text.
lines.Yang Earth: Tuesday feels heavy today. Break the big job into small bites, one at a time.
lines.Yin Earth: Someone in charge notices you today. Be the one who replies first and clearly.
lines.Yang Metal: A nice surprise could come today: a lead, a refund, a free kopi. Say yes, then check.
lines.Yin Metal: Track what you spend today. Spoiler: it's the delivery fees.
lines.Yang Water: Creative mood today. Make one thing; don't promise to make five.
lines.Yin Water: You'll say what everyone's thinking today. Brave. Maybe not in the group chat.
